guarantee: The Bash ERE `^[0-9]+$` at the PROCESS_PR dispatcher accepts only nonempty ASCII decimal-digit strings. This contract covers the regex condition only; positivity, exact action-field count, and the complete dispatch path are separate checks and are not proved by this property.
